executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: dietary cost per resident day ($5.78) was 20% of the Connecticut median ($29.51). Ask how dietary is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $234.8 per resident day (36.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 21.0% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $9,424, 0.2% of the $6,006,911 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $147,910, $5.78 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $147,910 (100.0%). Raw food was $142,133 ($5.56 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $98,648, $3.86 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $98,648 (100.0%).

Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 housekeeping is not used: outside the plausible range.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
